faq_heading: Hamilton real estate: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are closed sales from Jared’s Paragon export; local facts come from official sources listed at the bottom. It has no listing feed yet.

Hamilton is an MLS® sub-area of Richmond. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 74 homes sold there: 17 houses, 27 condos and 30 townhomes. 30 townhomes sold in Hamilton with a median price of $837,900 (the middle half sold between $705,000 and $899,000), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 3% sold above list.
Hamilton home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

30 townhomes sold in Hamilton with a median price of $837,900 (the middle half sold between $705,000 and $899,000), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.8% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $562 per square foot, a median year built of 2008 and a median strata fee of $381 a month. 27 condos sold in Hamilton with a median price of $587,000 (the middle half sold between $539,950 and $659,950), taking a median of 32 days to sell at 99.2% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $724 per square foot, a median year built of 2026 and a median strata fee of $420 a month.

items.t: The City has a Hamilton Area Plan (Bylaw 9000, Schedule 2.14) bounded by Westminster Highway, Boundary Road, Gilley Road, Highway 91, the North and South Arms of the Fraser River and New Westminster.
The City's trails vision for the area names McLean Park, Queensborough, Dyke Road and River Road.
The plan permits large and small lot single-family homes, townhouses and apartments up to four storeys.
Single-family designations carry floor-area ratios of 0.55, 0.60 and 0.75; townhouse areas 0.75 and stacked townhouse 1.00; village centre up to 1.50.
Industrial, mixed-employment and marine residential/industrial designations sit along the rivers.
Hamilton is not among the five transit-oriented areas, so the 2024 small-scale multi-unit housing (RSM) rules apply to its single-family lots.

blocks.text: Hamilton: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Hamilton Community Centre is at 5140 Smith Drive.
City park inventory lists McLean Neighbourhood Park (10.7 acres), Hamilton Community Park (12.4 acres), Hamilton Highway Park (7.2 acres) and North East Bog Forest.
The plan says the existing shopping centre and nearby Gilley Road properties may be redeveloped as a village centre, up to four storeys.
Hamilton Elementary is at 5180 Smith Drive.
The plan places the existing elementary school in its School designation.

blocks.text: Hamilton: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The plan says much of Hamilton has deep peat soils that are unstable and requires geotechnical and structural reports before construction.
It sits on the Fraser River floodplain; the plan requires dike upgrades, setbacks and flood construction levels.
ALR land forms a buffer along the west boundary, and the City does not support removing land from the ALR.
The plan was amended in June 2024 (Land Use Map and policies); confirm current designations with the City.
Richmond Fire-Rescue says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake.

faq.q: What did townhomes in Hamilton sell for?
faq.a: 30 townhomes sold in Hamilton between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $837,900.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Hamilton?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.8% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Hamilton sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 30 townhomes that sold in Hamilton went for between $705,000 and $899,000, around a median of $837,900.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Hamilton sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 30 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.8% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Hamilton?
faq.a: Of the 30 sales, 26 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $381.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Hamilton?
faq.a: The median year built was 2008 for the 30 townhomes sold in Hamilton.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Hamilton usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Hamilton had 3 bedrooms, from the 30 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Richmond?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.
